title: fix(objectql,rest,metadata-core)!: a datasource definition's stored row is served only to datasource administrators (#27884)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoLxa2hmovTvgRDEhw3svMof)_

Fixes #27884

Clause-②: no (narrowing for readers below datasource administration)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：数据源定义（datasource / external_catalog）所在的元数据存储行，现在只对持有 `manage_platform_settings` 的数据源管理员提供；与 `/meta` 类型读取门用的是同一张“类型→能力”表，没有新增规则、权限名或键。
- 为什么改：同一份数据源定义原来在两个出口对两组调用者开放，按裁决 A 统一为同一组读者；连接配置的问题也由本卡关闭。
- 风险与回滚：低于数据源管理员的读者不再能看到这些行（BREAKING 读集收窄，changeset 已写明补救）；管理员与系统读取不变；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-core/src/stored-metadata-type-read-admission.ts`（唯一的那张表），再看 `packages/objectql/src/stored-metadata-type-read-gate.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/stored-metadata-type-read-gate.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-type-read-stored-row-parity.test.ts`。
- 需要你做的：席位的契约复审（收窄一侧）后落地。

## What changes

A stored-row read exit admits only datasource administrators.

- **One row.** The type-to-capability table that the metadata read door already used moves to `@objectstack/metadata-core` as `STORED_METADATA_TYPE_READ_CAPABILITIES` (`datasource`, `external_catalog` → `manage_platform_settings`), with `storedMetadataTypesWithheldFrom(caller)` and `isCapabilityGatedStoredMetadataType(type)`. `@objectstack/rest` keeps exporting `META_TYPE_READ_CAPABILITIES`, now the same frozen object; the metadata read door answers exactly as before.
- **The stored row.** The engine applies that same row to every caller-context read of the stored-metadata tables (`find`, `findOne`, `count`, `aggregate`): a caller without a type's capability is served no row of that type, and a read of such a row's id answers as a read of a row that does not exist. Holders of the capability, platform administrators among them, are served everything as before; system reads are unchanged.
- **Events.** A record-change event of a row of a gated type carries no metadata body to any subscriber.
- **Docs.** The isSystem census page gains the row for the new gate's system-read exemption (generated register refreshed).
- No new rule, permission name or key. No `packages/spec` change, no `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` change.

## Why

Ruling A on #27884 (record 6545628488): one document admits one set of callers at every exit that serves it, reusing the one capability row the `/meta` type gate names. Caller-aware redaction and a redactor-type parameter are out of scope.

## Verification

- Unit pins (objectql): an administrator reads the row whole; a caller below datasource administration and a plain reader are served no gated row on find / findOne / count / aggregate; the history table is gated by the same row; a system read is not narrowed; the composed predicate names exactly the withheld types; events of gated rows withhold the body while an ungated row keeps it.
- Parity pins (rest): `META_TYPE_READ_CAPABILITIES` is the shared frozen row, and for six callers the metadata door refuses a type exactly when the stored-row gate withholds it.
- Dogfood (booted stack, platform security composition): an administrator is served the row whole; callers below datasource administration are served nothing; for each caller the stored row is served exactly when the metadata door serves the definition.
- Ablations, each red then restored byte-identical: gate removed (4 objectql pins red), row withheld from everyone (3 red, the administrator pin among them), event arm removed (2 red), a second copy of the row in rest (3 parity pins red), gate removed from the built objectql dist (dogfood + parity pins red).
- Suites: objectql 506 files / 9836 tests passed; metadata-core + rest 21 files / 875 tests passed; typecheck of the three packages exit 0; scoped `eslint` over the touched files exit 0; derived gates all exit 0 on the final head (record below); full `@objectstack/dogfood` battery on the final head (record below).

<!-- verification-record -->
Verification record, head `1e838c5c` (the final head `757ff0c5` adds one changeset wording commit; the five changeset gates and `clause2-line` re-ran there, all exit 0, and the derivation is unchanged):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` → 94 derived commands, all run with `</dev/null`, all `exit 0`; `dispatch-gates --ran` → 94 derived, 94 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Fixed during the sweep: `check:objectql-double-limit` (pin driver honours the limit), `check:query-options-erasure` (typed query options, test surface back to 236), `check:where-matcher` (pin matcher refuses unknown combinators), `check:system-context-census` (census row 18d + regenerated register).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` (whole battery, under the verify lock, concurrent with the gate sweep): 361 files passed, 3 skipped, 1 failed — `automation-authoring-doors-durable.dogfood.test.ts`, a 5000 ms test timeout on a flow update under the shared load; that file re-run alone on the same head: 7/7 passed.
- `npx eslint` over the touched source and test files: exit 0.

Clause-② and Metadata-protocol are declared on the lines above and in the changeset.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` untouched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (scoped to the touched files).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 section is the maintainer's Chinese digest).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## Acceptance notes

- Readers below datasource administration are no longer served stored datasource or federation-catalog rows; the remedy is to grant `manage_platform_settings` or read through the datasource admin door as such a caller.
- Owed before landing: the seat's contract review of the narrowing arm.
